usage: cox route [-h]
                 {context,status,file,priority,pull,lint,groups,drift,import,approve,decline,chair,sync,launch}
                 ...

File work for the harness, and see what is queued or running.

positional arguments:
  {context,status,file,priority,pull,lint,groups,drift,import,approve,decline,chair,sync,launch}
    context             the routing profile's resolved context
    status              what is queued or running for this profile
    file                file a new ticket for the harness
    priority            move an initiative up or down the launch order
    pull                file intake tickets from a source, once per link
    lint                static ticket lint over a filed initiative, work-shape.md §3
    groups              print the newest plans/intake-groups/<date>.md file, work-shape.md §5
    drift               items whose store state and file state differ
    import              load the current work item files into the store's work_items table
    approve             approve a draft initiative's todo tickets: todo becomes ready
    decline             decline a draft initiative: its todo tickets become dropped
    chair               the chair lock for the landing loop (runs/chair.json)
    sync                mirror the work store onto the profile's tracker
    launch              run one of the harness's graphs directly

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

examples:
  cox route launch epic --initiative work/<id> --repo PATH
  cox route status --profile PATH
